body.name: Zero and positive population-variance witnesses
body.construction: Let \(U_i\) be independent Rademacher variables, let \(G\) be the deterministic nearest-neighbor line, take \(E_i(d,G)=d_i\), \(e_1=1\), \(e_0=0\), and define \(P^{\Delta}\) by \(Y_i(d;U,G)=(U_i-U_{i-1})d_i\) and \(P^{+}\) by \(Y_i(d;U,G)=U_id_i\), with the two assignment waves drawn independently at probability \(p\).
